item.title: Less Chat, More Answer: Site AI Chatbots Need to Get to the Point
item.content:encoded: Users turn to site-specific chatbots for quick answers, not a conversation. Design responses that are direct, scannable, and easy to expand when needed.

item.title: Handmade Designs: The New Trust Signal
item.content:encoded: In an era of AI-generated-everything, AI-fatigued users want designs that look like they were made by a person.

item.title: AI Agents as Users
item.content:encoded: AI agents now interact with digital interfaces alongside humans. Designing for both requires rethinking what "user" means and prioritizing accessibility.

item.title: AI Can Help with Survey Writing, But It Still Requires Human Expertise
item.content:encoded: AI can produce polished survey drafts quickly, but experienced human review is still needed to catch subtle survey-design flaws that weaken data quality.

item.title: A Concrete Definition of an AI Agent
item.content:encoded: An AI agent pursues a goal by iteratively taking actions, evaluating progress, and deciding next steps. Useful agents must be reliable, adaptive, and accurate.

item.title: GenUI vs. Vibe Coding: Who’s Designing?
item.content:encoded: With generative UI, the AI system decides to generate an interactive element or entire product in response to a user need. Vibe coding is when users request the AI to build it.
